title: Without See Financial Data a part's category change stays on the page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has the inventory permissions needed to edit an inventory part but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, so part A starts in it.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A, so the test can move it.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open part A in the inventory.
  2. Pick category B as part A's category.
  3. Save the part.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's inventory part dialog opens.

Step 2:

  • Category B is picked and the dialog stays open.
  • No Access Denied page appears.

Step 3:

  • Part A saves in category B.
  • The user stays on the inventory page.
